checks.name: required_assets
checks.requirement: all source, master, data, QA, and archive inputs exist

checks.name: png_600_dpi
checks.requirement: PNG metadata is 600 dpi

checks.name: png_dimensions
checks.requirement: PNG pixels match final size at 600 dpi

checks.name: pdf_one_page
checks.requirement: PDF has one page

checks.name: pdf_dimensions
checks.requirement: PDF matches 177.8 x 132.08 mm

checks.name: svg_vector_text
checks.requirement: SVG is vector-only and keeps editable text

checks.name: qa_dimensions
checks.requirement: QA surfaces match final print size at 180 dpi

checks.name: grayscale_contrast
checks.requirement: grayscale standard deviation exceeds 20

checks.name: certificate_window_grid
checks.requirement: both routes contain the exact 4 R x 2 regime x 3 level grid

checks.name: certificate_exact_degeneracy
checks.requirement: both routes verify U'(0)=U''(0)=0 and U'''(0)=R(2R+1) != 0

checks.name: certificate_exact_exponents
checks.requirement: independent exact ledgers agree and give the lifted one-carrier exponent 11/6

checks.name: certificate_crosscheck
checks.requirement: crosscheck passes and all route differences are <= 2e-12

checks.name: certificate_ed_endpoint_order
checks.requirement: ED equals old at epsilon=1, is strictly smaller for epsilon>1, and has ratio epsilon^(-1/2)

checks.name: data_completeness
checks.requirement: data.csv has all four panels and at least 900 traceable rows

checks.name: panel_a_scale_formulas
checks.requirement: Panel A directly evaluates the old and ED one-carrier window formulas

checks.name: panel_b_ed_endpoint_order
checks.requirement: Panel B says no larger, equal at epsilon=1, and strictly smaller for every epsilon>1

checks.name: panel_b_fixed_r_boundary
checks.requirement: at fixed R the improved current bound still crosses the scale-one guide

checks.name: panel_c_claim_status
checks.requirement: only the declared N=1 point is unconditional; the full multi-carrier curve is conditional

checks.name: panel_d_exact_obstruction
checks.requirement: Panel D encodes the exact flat critical point separately from the Morse reference

checks.name: source_lineage
checks.requirement: analytic, certificate, contract, caption, and plotting sources retain build hashes

checks.name: public_byte_identity
checks.requirement: public masters are byte-identical to archival masters

checks.name: claim_boundary
checks.requirement: caption and contract preserve endpoint, conditionality, fixed-R, and Clay-problem boundaries

checks.name: no_simulation_or_fit
checks.requirement: the figure is exact-algebra extraction with no PDE evolution, regression, fit, or certificate interpolation

checks.name: visual_inspection_declared
checks.requirement: final-size, grayscale, and PDF-raster surfaces were explicitly inspected
